_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); electric utility signals on FPL Group's own lines

pit_profile.why: NextEra Energy, Inc.: 'FPL is a rate-regulated electric utility engaged primarily in the generation, storage, transmission, distribution and sale of electric energy in Florida.' and 'NEER’s strategic focus is centered on the development, construction and operation of long-term contracted generation facilities, including renewables, nuclear and natural gas, as well as battery storage facilities.'; among its risk factors, 'NEE's and FPL's business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects may be materially adversely affected by the extensive regulation of their business.', 'NEE's and FPL's business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects can be materially adversely affected by weather conditions and related impacts, including, but not limited to, the impact of severe weather.' and 'NEE's and FPL's business could be negatively affected by federal or state laws or regulations mandating new or additional limits on the production of greenhouse gas emissions.' (its own FY2025 10-K); ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12, scoped to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining'): NEER holds oil and gas production assets and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for NextEra Energy (the XOM and SO rule); of the other live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names an electric utility

theme_watch.reason: Live: NextEra Energy's own FY2025 10-K says 'NEER's natural gas and oil production assets represented approximately 13% and 15% of NEER's depreciable electric plant in service and other property as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.' and, of greenhouse gas limits on its fossil-fuelled units, 'The results of operations of NEE and FPL could be materially adversely affected to the extent that new federal or state laws or regulations impose any new greenhouse gas emission limits.' The stock trades at 27.6x FY26E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ENERGY_TRANSITION) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing decarbonisation of NextEra Energy's gas reserves and fossil units specifically.

(its own FY2025 10-K); ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12, scoped to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining'): NEER holds oil and gas production assets and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for NextEra Energy (the XOM and SO rule); of the other live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names an electric utility. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.88x; +45% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.92; conservative 2yr +16%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -44.1%/yr (worst year FY16-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +19.5%/yr (Q4 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.5%/yr (FY16-FY25 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +49.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NEE (retrospective, 2026-03-06) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.88x (85.7% downside to Bear $13 / +97.8% upside to Bull $180) | Adj composite 3.06 vs market 2.14: gap +0.92 [UNDERVALUED] | +45% above the EPP floor $63 (19x FY26E $3.30) | Conservative 2-yr case: +15.8% total (+7.9%/yr) | At 27.6x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $120 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; FPL energy sales n/r in Q4 2025, forward revenues +20.7% (no Q1 2026 revenue guide, Q4 2025 revenue as reported); the energy transition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
